features.name: Ambient responses
features.description: Responds to selected phrases with jokes, replies, or emoji reactions.
features.details: These lightweight responses are limited to supported channels and threads. Some are seasonal, and the full trigger list is intentionally left as a surprise.

features.name: Birthday celebrations
features.description: Posts configured birthday announcements and advance reminders.
features.details: A configured celebration may include an announcement, an individual greeting, and a placeholder Discord event. Personal names and dates are not included in this public reference.

features.name: Instagram embed fixes
features.description: Replies to supported Instagram links with an embed-friendly replacement.
features.details: When the replacement embeds successfully, Ulfgar Bot suppresses the original embed. Wrap a link in Discord spoiler markers or angle brackets when you do not want it replaced.

features.name: Recurring-event automation
features.description: Publishes weekly event announcements and maintains their interactive controls.
features.details: Event posts can provide attendance choices and a Remind Me control. Reminder subscriptions continue across future occurrences until removed.

features.name: Scheduled-event reminders
features.description: Publishes a reminder when a configured Discord scheduled event occurs that day.
features.details: Birthday placeholder events are excluded. Reminder controls on an announcement may be used to request a personal notification.

features.name: Seasonal and calendar posts
features.description: Publishes selected holiday, weekday, and calendar-based messages or media.
features.details: Supported holidays may also add a themed reaction to messages. Individual media schedules and surprise posts are intentionally not listed.

features.name: Server artwork
features.description: Updates configured server icons, banners, and bot artwork for dates and events.
features.details: Artwork can change daily or at selected times for holidays and community occasions. Manual artwork commands remain documented with their command families.

features.name: Wednesday reminders
features.description: Posts weekly reminders for the configured Wednesday gathering.
features.details: The reminder day follows reschedules and cancellations made through the Wednesday command family, and the associated server artwork follows the adjusted week.

features.name: Wordle reminders
features.description: Posts a daily reminder and link for the community Wordle thread.
features.details: The reminder appears automatically in the configured Wordle discussion.

features.name: WoW dungeon signups
features.description: Publishes recurring World of Warcraft dungeon signup posts.
features.details: Use the role buttons on a signup post to join or leave as damage, healer, or tank. The displayed roster updates after each selection.
